name: deleteStoragePartition
description: Delete everything the kept session `name` stored (webWindow.open storagePartition): cookies and site data. The same name opens an empty session afterwards. invalid_args when the name is not 8 to 32 lower-case letters, and while a window of this profile is open in that session. Answers once the data is gone. Manifest primitive webWindow.storagePartition. Returns { ok: true }.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The kept session's name, as given to open's storagePartition.
